title: AGP signed immutable deployment plan v1alpha1
description: Structural execution-purpose envelope, not proof of approvals, qualification or live authority. Ed25519 signature uses AGP-DEPLOYMENT-PLAN-v1 plus newline and the canonical envelope digest with empty signature. Signature is unpadded Base64url. Pilot plan limit 2 MiB, fleet plan 32 MiB, envelope overhead at most 4096 bytes; helper admission currently accepts pilot plans only.
